steps.en: Pressing proceed checks the form first
steps.id: Menekan lanjut mengecek form lebih dulu

steps.en: A summary of the suspension is shown to confirm
steps.why_en: The summary sits in a separate tab; the confirmation pop-up itself does not show it.
steps.why_id: Ringkasan ada di tab terpisah; pop-up konfirmasi sendiri tidak menampilkannya.

steps.en: After agreeing, the suspension is submitted for all notices
steps.id: Setelah setuju, suspensi dikirim untuk semua notice

steps.en: The outcome for each notice is shown afterwards
